sentences.en: The artists pledged to contribute all his property to charity.
sentences.zh: 艺术家们承诺将他所有的财产捐给慈善机构。

sentences.en: In Algeria, very few Islamist groups pledged loyalty to ISIS.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及利亚，很少有伊斯兰极端组织向ISIS效忠。

sentences.en: I give my pledge that I will quit smoking.
